title: The $81 Million Heist Hidden by a Printer

lines.text: February twenty sixteen. A quiet morning in Dhaka.
Inside the dealing room, the official SWIFT printer sat dead silent.
Its tray sat empty, mistaken by staff for a routine paper jam.
Overnight, hackers breached the terminal, sending thirty-five orders for nearly one billion dollars.
Custom malware wiped the queue, silencing physical confirmations.
Eighty-one million escaped to Manila casinos through fake accounts.
Twenty million was stopped by pure luck: a single typo, 'Fundation'.
The New York Fed blocked eight hundred and fifty million more.
By Saturday, when the printer restarted, the cash was gone.
A decade later, sixty-six million dollars is still missing.
